questions.question: A mixture of 240 litres of juice and contains 15% water. How much more water (in litres) should be added to this so that the strength of water will become 25% in the new mixture?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Quantity of water in the mixture of 240 litres = 15% of 240 = 36 litres

Let the extra water added be x

So, water become (36 + x) litres and mixture become (240 + x) litres

According to question,

(36 + x) /(240 + x) = 25/100

⇒ (36 + x) /(240 + x) = 1/4

⇒ 4 × (36 + x) = (240 + x)

⇒ 144 + 4x = 240 + x

⇒ 3x = 240 – 144 = 96

⇒ x = 32

**∴ Extra water should be added to make water 25% = 32 litres**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

We know, 15% = 3/20 and 25% = 1/4

At first, juice contains 15% water,

We can say 3 unit of water and 17 unit of juice 

Then some water is added and water becomes 25%

So, we can say 1 unit of water and 3 unit of juice 

Now, no change in the juice, so we have to do equal juice unit

Before water added total mixtue (51 + 9) = 60 unit → 240 ltr

Water added (17 - 9) = 8 unit → 240/60 × 8 = 32 ltr

questions.question: The sum of the present ages of a father and his son is 126 years. 8 years ago their respective ages were in the ratio of 7 : 4. After 7 years what will be the ratio of ages of father and son?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

8 year ago the ratio of age of father and his son was 7 : 4

**Calculation:**

Let the father and son age be 7x and 4x respectivily

Present age of father and son is (7x + 8) and (4x + 8) respectivily

According to question,

(7x + 8) + (4x + 8) = 126

⇒ 11x + 16 = 126

⇒ x = 10

Present age of father = (7x + 8) = 78 years and present age of son = (4x + 8) = 48 years

After 7 years, father = 78 + 7 = 85 years and son = 48 + 7 = 55 years

**∴ After 7 years the ratio of ages of father and son = 85 : 55 = 17 : 11**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**

sum of the present ages of a father and his son is 126 years.

8 years ago sum of their ages is 126 - (8 × 2) = 110

Here, 8 years ago Father : Son = 7 : 4,

So, at this time father's age 7/11 × 110 = 70 years, son's age 40 years

Now, Aftre 7 years from the present ratio of their ages will be

Father : Son = (70 + 8 + 7) : (40 + 8 + 7)

Father : Son = 85 : 55

Father : Son = 17 : 11

questions.question: The ratio of spirit and water in the two vessels is 5 : 1 and 3 : 7 respectively. In what ratio the liquid of both the vessels should be mixed such that a new mixture containing half spirit and half water is obtained?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the alligation method on the fractional part of the spirit:

Spirit part in Vessel 1 = 5/6 and in Vessel 2 = 3/10.

Target mixture has half spirit, so Mean = 1/2.

Ratio = (Mean − Vessel 2) : (Vessel 1 − Mean)

Ratio = (1/2 − 3/10) : (5/6 − 1/2) = 1/5 : 1/3 = 3 : 5.

**∴ The correct answer is 3 : 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of spirit and water in Vessel 1 = 5 : 1

Ratio of spirit and water in Vessel 2 = 3 : 7

Target mixture ratio (half spirit, half water) = 1 : 1

**Formula Used:**

Alligation Rule: Ratio of Quantity = (Mean Value − Cheaper Value) : (Dearer Value − Mean Value)

 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Vessel 1
 Vessel 2
 Mean
 
 5/6
 3/10
 1/2
 1/5
 1/3
 
 Ratio = 1/5 : 1/3 = 3 : 5

**Calculations:**

⇒ Fraction of spirit in Vessel 1 = 5 ÷ (5 + 1) = 5/6

⇒ Fraction of spirit in Vessel 2 = 3 ÷ (3 + 7) = 3/10

⇒ Fraction of spirit in the Target Mean Mixture = 1 ÷ (1 + 1) = 1/2

⇒ Left side difference (Vessel 1 quantity ratio) = 1/2 − 3/10 = 2/10 = 1/5

⇒ Right side difference (Vessel 2 quantity ratio) = 5/6 − 1/2 = 2/6 = 1/3

⇒ The required mixing ratio = 1/5 : 1/3

⇒ Multiplying both sides by the LCM of denominators (15) to simplify:

⇒ Required Ratio = (1/5 × 15) : (1/3 × 15) = 3 : 5

**∴ The correct answer is 3 : 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Rule of Alligation

A practical method to find the ratio in which two ingredients at different given values must be mixed to produce a mixture of a specified mean value. It visualizes the process through a simple cross-difference diagram.

LCM Equal Proportions Trick

When combining multiple mixtures manually without alligation, calculate the total unit parts of each mixture and multiply them to match their LCM. This ensures smooth addition of the corresponding components.

Repeated Dilution Formula

If a vessel contains **a** units of pure liquid and **b** units are repeatedly drawn and replaced with water **n** times, the remaining pure liquid quantity = a × (1 − b/a)ⁿ.

questions.question: 10 Consecutive numbers are given. If the average of the two numbers given in the middle is 13.5, then what is the sum of the ﬁrst 6 numbers?
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

5th and 6th numbers are in the middle of 10 consecutive numbers

**Calculation:**

Let the 5th and 6th number be x and (x + 1) respectivily

∵ Average of the two numbers given in the middle is 13.5

 Sum of two number = 13.5 × 2

⇒ x + (x + 1) = 13.5 × 2

⇒ 2x + 1 = 27

⇒ x = 13

The 5th and 6th number is 13 and 14 respectivily

The ﬁrst 6 numbers are 9, 10, 11, 12, 13 and 14

**∴ The sum of the ﬁrst 6 numbers = 9 + 10 + 11 + 12 + 13 + 14 = 69**

questions.question: A sum of Rs 4000 becomes Rs 7000 in 6 years at simple interest. If the rate of interest becomes double of itself, then what will be the amount (in Rs) after 6 years?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Simple Interest for 6 years = 7000 − 4000 = ₹3000

Since Simple Interest is directly proportional to the Rate of Interest.

When the rate of interest is doubled, the interest for the same period will also double.

New Interest = 2 × 3000 = ₹6000

New Amount = Principal + New Interest = 4000 + 6000 = ₹10000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹10000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 Principal
 ₹4000
 
 

 

 
 

 

 
 
 Rate = R%
 SI = ₹3000
 
 
 Rate = 2R%
 SI = ₹6000
 
 
• 
 

 
 
• 
 

 
 
 Amount 1
 ₹7000
 
 
 Amount 2
 ₹10000

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹4000

Amount (A₁) = ₹7000

Time (T) = 6 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = Amount − Principal

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

**Calculations:**

⇒ Original SI = 7000 − 4000 = ₹3000

⇒ Simple interest is directly proportional to the rate of interest (SI ∝ R).

⇒ When the rate is doubled, the interest will also double (since Time and Principal are constant).

⇒ New SI = 2 × 3000 = ₹6000

⇒ New Amount = Principal + New SI

⇒ New Amount = 4000 + 6000 = ₹10000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹10000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Proportionality

Simple Interest is directly proportional to Principal (P), Rate (R), and Time (T). If any one of these factors is multiplied by 'n', the simple interest is also scaled by exactly 'n'.

Amount Formula

The final Amount is the sum of Principal and the Simple Interest accumulated over the given time period. The general formula used is: A = P + SI = P × (1 + (R × T) ÷ 100).

Simple Interest vs Compound Interest

Unlike Compound Interest, Simple Interest is calculated exclusively on the original principal. Therefore, any linear change in the interest rate reflects linearly in the total interest.

questions.question: If the selling price of 39 articles is equal to the cost price of 42 articles, then what will be the proﬁt percentage?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Selling price (SP) of 39 articles = Cost price (CP) of 42 articles

**Calculation:**

SP × 39 = CP × 42

⇒ SP/CP = 14/13

Profite = 14 – 13 = 1

**∴ Profit % = (1/13) × 100 = 7.69%**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**

**Concept used:**

In article-based problems

If cost article > selling article, there is profit and 

If selling article > cost article, there is loss

Profit% = (Cost article - Selling article)/Selling article × 100

**Calculation:**

According to the question, cost article > selling article so there is profit

Profit% = (42 - 39)/39 × 100 = 7.69%

**∴ The correct answer is 7.69%**

questions.question: The marked price of a trouser is twice of the cost price. To earn 36% proﬁt, what should be the value of discount (in percentage)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked price (MP) of a trouser = 2 × the cost price (CP)

⇒ MP/CP = 2/1

**Calculation:**

Let MP is m% more than the CP

m = [(MP – CP) /CP] × 100

⇒ m = 100%

∵ p = m – d – (m × d) /100 [∵ p = profit% and d = discount%]

⇒ 36 = 100 – d – (100 × d) /100

⇒ 36 = 100 – 2d

⇒ d = 64/2 = 32%

**∴ discount = 32%**

P can make a table in 16 days while Q can make it in 20 days. Q started the work and did that work for 5 days. In how many days P can complete the remaining work?
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

Total work = efficiency × time

**Calculation:**

P and Q can make a table in 16 days and 20 days respectivily

P’s single day work = 1/16

Q’s single day work = 1/20

Q’s single 5 day work = (1/20) × 5 = ¼

Remaining work to do = 1 – ¼ = 3/4

**∴ P can complete the remaining work = (¾) ÷ (1/16) = 12 days**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** P can do the work in 16 days and Q can do that in 20 days

LCM of 16, 20 = 80 (total work)

Efficiency of P is 80/16 = 5 unit and for Q is 80/20 = 4 unit

In first 5 days Q done 4 × 5 = 20 unit of work,

The remaining work is (80 - 20) = 60 unit

P will done the remaining work in 60/5 = 12 days

questions.question: The length and breadth of a rectangle are 15 cm and 8 cm respectively. Calculate its perimeter (in cm).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The length and breadth of a rectangle are 15 cm and 8 cm

**Formula used:**

Perimeter of rectangle = 2(length + breadth)

**Calculation:**

Perimeter of rectangle = 2(length + breadth)

⇒ Perimeter of rectangle = 2(15 + 8) = 46 cm

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**

questions.question: If the area of a semi-circle is 693 cm², then ﬁnd its radius (in cm).
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

• Area of semi-circle = 1/2 × (area of circle) = 1/2 × πr²

**Calculation:**

⇒ 693 = (22/7) × r²/2

⇒ r² = (693 × 7 × 2) /22

⇒ r = 21

**∴ Radius of semi-circle = 21 cm**

diameter of circular cone = 24 cm and slant height (l) = 14 cm
